eglise.name: L'église : la nef
eglise.alt: Inside the village church, painted in ink and gouache: a model ship hangs over the nave, a carved pulpit, a statue with a pigeon, a wedding party in the aisle, an old parishioner arranging sunflowers, a stained-glass window and pews; a door on the left opens onto the sunny square and an open side door on the right leads back to the village lane.

doors.label: Le parvis
doors.hint: Step out onto the church square

doors.label: La sacristie
doors.hint: Through the little blue door to the sacristy

items.scene: A model ship (navis, 'ship' in Latin) hangs over the long NAVE: the nave is the 'ship' of the church.
The PARISH noticeboard, with a parrot ('pa-RWAHS') perched beside the notices.
The carved wooden PULPIT high above the nave, with a red armCHAIR tucked in it.
A little candle does the BOOGIE on the pew back.
The COLLECTION basket, with a toy knight setting off on his QUEST.
A mother duck leads a candlelit PROCESSION of ducklings round the nave.
A FAITHFUL believer prays in her pew, with her faithful spotted dog, Fido.
A wedding CORTÈGE walks slowly up the aisle.
A tall CHURCH CANDLE beside the altar, watched by a wise old owl in spectacles (the 'old seer').
A PARISHIONER arranges sunflowers in a stone vase.
A painted path (un chemin) winding up to a cross: one of the STATIONS OF THE CROSS on the wall.
A little model church shows the TRANSEPT, the cross-arm, with candles along it.
The PEW (BAHN), with a giant bonbon left on it.
A padded KNEELER (prie-Dieu) in front of a pew.

parvis.name: Le parvis et le clocher
parvis.alt: The church square painted in ink and gouache: a stone arcade with a bronze bell, a ginger cat with a bell collar, a painted Easter egg on the steps, a valley of churches, domes and a round tower, a family waving, a holy-water stoup and the carved church portal with its oak door.

doors.label: La nef
doors.hint: Back inside the church through the oak door

items.scene: A big bronze church BELL hangs under the arcade, shaped a little like a cloche hat.
The stone ARCADE, its arches marching along the square.
A ginger cat wears a SMALL BELL on its collar.
A painted Easter EGG ('ay-GLEEZ') on the steps, with a CHURCH painted on it.
A little stone CHAPEL on the hilltop.
A great gothic CATHEDRAL with spiky towers in the valley.
A grand domed BASILICA on the hillside.
A pigeon COOs from the top of a golden DOME.
A round TOWER on the crag, with a tour group gazing up.
The village BELL TOWER across the valley.
A family gathers on the church FORECOURT.
The carved stone PORTAL of the church (its oak door leads back inside).

sacristie.name: La sacristie
sacristie.alt: The sacristy painted in ink and gouache: the open blue door back to the nave, a small picture of a sacristy, a black cassock with sunglasses on a peg, cruets on a tray, an altar server holding a candle, the tall oak armoire, a folded amice, a hanging censer, a box of incense and the sacristan lighting candles.

doors.label: La nef
doors.hint: Back through the blue door to the nave

zooms.label: l'armoire
zooms.hint: Open the armoire to see the vestments

items.scene: A little picture of the SACRISTY, vestments hanging in its wardrobe.
A priest's black CASSOCK hangs on a hook, with sunglasses for SOO-TAHN (sun-tan).
A little brass box of INCENSE, a curl of smoke rising.

armoire.name: L'armoire
armoire.alt: The open oak armoire from the sacristy: a purple stole on the left door, a white alb with a rooster on its hanger, a green chasuble, a white-and-gold dalmatic above a sleeping Dalmatian puppy, and a lacy white surplice on the right.

items.scene: A rooster crows at DAWN on the hanger of the white ALB.
A deacon's DALMATIC with wide sleeves, and a sleepy Dalmatian puppy underneath.
